provenance.feature_level: gene/protein-level N-glycoprotein-enriched surfaceome, NOT intact glycopeptides or glycosites
provenance.row_annotation_limit: Author GLYCO matrix provides gene names only. Do not invent peptide sequences, UniProt accession, glycosites or glycan compositions.
provenance.assay_semantics: Native author-processed expression matrix. Methods describe log2 transformation, quantile normalization, LLS imputation, and zero-centering for subsequent analyses; exact batch-correction stage of this published sheet is not explicit. Preserve original values, not raw intensity, no additional imputation/transformation.
provenance.author_imputation: LLS reported by authors; these are author values, not newly imputed in GlyHub preparation.
provenance.excluded_omics: Do not import total proteome, phosphoproteome, metabolome, transcriptome, CCLE or TCGA as new glycoproteomic data.
provenance.status: complete_author_matrix_and_sample_mapping_verified; gene-level surfaceome schema eligibility requires writer decision
provenance.license_scope: CC BY 4.0 original-author GLYCO supplementary matrix; no separate exclusion identified. Format conversion only.
